address: Crazy Bear Hotel, 73-75 Wycombe End, Beaconsfield,HP9 1LX
bio: Experience the unrivalled charm of Afternoon Tea at The Crazy Bear Beaconsfield. Indulge in an assortment of treats and luxurious teas in this fifteenth century coaching inn, creating a truly memorable experience.  Afternoon Tea is served in the acclaimed English Restaurant or the Moroccan Lounge, both designed with dramatic architecture and uncompromised luxury. Please let the venue know if you have any specific seating requests.  The menu features a selection of sumptuous finger sandwiches, handcrafted pastries, teacakes and scones. Afternoon Tea is served with the finest hand-picked teas, with the option of adding a glass of Champagne for that extra sense of luxury.  The Crazy Bear is located in Beaconsfield, not too far from Beaconsfield Station.
